Nucleic Acids Res 19(16):4523-4529 (sequence-of-record for this deposit; establishes the C-terminal homology to ExoIII/APE-family repair endo/exonucleases). Sander M, Lowenhaupt K, Rich A (1991) Drosophila Rrp1 protein: an apurinic endonuclease with homologous recombination activities. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 88(15):6780-6784, PMID 1713691 (establishes AP-endonuclease activity biochemically).
corpus_row.expected_class: not a TE - host AP (apurinic/apyrimidinic) endonuclease and strand transferase Rrp1, a single-copy DNA-repair gene
corpus_row.why_safe: Confusion axis: the Rrp1 C-terminal domain belongs to the Exo_endo_phos / DNase-I-like nuclease superfamily - the same fold as E. coli exonuclease III, human APE1 and the endonuclease (EN) domain of LINE-1 ORF2p - so an EN-domain-keyed TE caller is at genuine risk of flagging it. Tool-independence: AP-endonuclease and strand-transfer activities were measured on purified protein in vitro; the label rests on enzymology, not on similarity to a TE library. The record is an mRNA (complete cds) of a single-copy nuclear repair gene, so it cannot harbour an intronic element, and it carries no RT, no transposase and no terminal repeats. Complements the excluded human APEX1 row (NG_008718) with an invertebrate representative of the same fold.
